name: Complete a purchase of a single product
fullName: SauceDemo.UiTests/Features/Checkout/Complete a purchase of a single product

steps.name: Given I log in with my assigned user
When I add "Sauce Labs Backpack" to the cart
When I go to the cart
When I fill in my checkout information
Then the order total should be a positive dollar amount
Then I should see the order confirmation "Thank you for your order!"
